title: Covering Bridgeless Claw-Free Cubic Graphs with Perfect Matchings
summary: The Berge conjecture [Proc. London Math. Soc., 1979] asserts that every bridgeless cubic graph can be covered by five perfect matchings. The 5-cycle double cover conjecture, proposed independently by Preissmann (1981) and Celmins (1984), asserts that every bridgeless graph admits five even subgraphs such that every edge belongs to exactly two of them. Hakobyan and Mkrtchyan [Ars Math. Contemp., 2019] proved that the 5-cycle double cover conjecture holds if and only if every bridgeless claw-free cubic graph can be covered by four perfect matchings.
